svg.title: sd hire_andres
svg.desc: Sequence diagram hire_andres. 1: you to andrés, goal(outcome, constraints). 2: andrés to andrés, design(): ADRs, DDD, events. 3: andrés to agents, spec(feature). 4: agents to agents, build(): harness, skills, MCP. 5: agents to andrés, pull request, reviewed. 6: andrés to camel, route(): EIP on Camel + Quarkus. 7: camel to kafka, publish(events): CDC, Streams. 8: kafka to camel, ack. 9: andrés to prod, deploy(): tested, observed. 10: prod to you, value, every sprint. Messages 3 to 9 run inside loop every sprint. Note: goals, not hours; quality, not luck; better each sprint.
